cypher.query:
MATCH (g:Gene) WHERE g.id IN ["ENSG00000001626", "ENSG00000128534"]
CALL (g) {
  MATCH (g)-[gt:HAS_TRANSCRIPT]-(t:Transcript)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[tss_r:HAS_TSS]-(tss:TSS_segment)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[exon_r:HAS_EXON]-(exon:Exon)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[cds_r:HAS_CDS_SEGMENT]-(cds:CDS_segments)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[utr_r:HAS_UTR_SEGMENT]-(utr:UTR_segments)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[tp_r:TRANSLATES_TO]-(protein:Protein)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[gp_r:ENCODES]-(protein)
  WITH t, gt,
       collect(DISTINCT tss) AS tss_nodes, collect(DISTINCT tss_r) AS tss_edges,
       collect(DISTINCT exon) AS exon_nodes, collect(DISTINCT exon_r) AS exon_edges,
       collect(DISTINCT cds) AS cds_nodes, collect(DISTINCT cds_r) AS cds_edges,
       collect(DISTINCT utr) AS utr_nodes, collect(DISTINCT utr_r) AS utr_edges,
       collect(DISTINCT protein) AS protein_nodes,
       collect(DISTINCT tp_r) AS transcript_protein_edges,
       collect(DISTINCT gp_r) AS gene_protein_edges
  RETURN [t] + tss_nodes + exon_nodes + cds_nodes + utr_nodes + protein_nodes AS structure_nodes,
         [gt] + tss_edges + exon_edges + cds_edges + utr_edges + transcript_protein_edges + gene_protein_edges AS structure_edges
}
CALL (g) {
  OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[go_r:ASSOCIATED_WITH_GO]-(go:GO_term)
  WITH go_r, go LIMIT 2
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT go) AS go_nodes, collect(DISTINCT go_r) AS go_edges
}
WITH collect(DISTINCT g) AS genes,
     collect(structure_nodes) AS structure_node_lists,
     collect(structure_edges) AS structure_edge_lists,
     collect(go_nodes) AS go_node_lists,
     collect(go_edges) AS go_edge_lists
WITH genes
   + reduce(acc = [], item IN structure_node_lists | acc + item)
   + reduce(acc = [], item IN go_node_lists | acc + item) AS nodes,
     reduce(acc = [], item IN structure_edge_lists | acc + item)
   + reduce(acc = [], item IN go_edge_lists | acc + item) AS edges
RETURN nodes, edges
